summary: This is an 8-K filed by Jaguar Health, Inc. to disclose a new manufacturing and supply agreement (the 2026 Agreement) between its subsidiary Napo Pharmaceuticals and Alivus Life Sciences for the production of crofelemer. The agreement replaces a prior 2020 agreement and runs through March 2029 with minimum purchase commitments. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist, spin-off, etc.) is present; this is a routine supply arrangement for an existing product. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement disclosure under Item 1.01, not a transformative event.
